scripts.build: npm run build:devora-code && concurrently -n "jira,webview" -c "green,yellow" "npm run build:devora-code-jira" "npm run build:webview"
scripts.package: npm run build && concurrently -n "core,jira" -c "blue,green" "npm run package -w devora-code-core" "npm run package -w devora-code-jira"
scripts.watch:all: concurrently --kill-others -n "core,jira,webview,api,sdk" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan" "npm run watch -w devora-code-core" "npm run watch -w devora-code-jira" "npm run watch --prefix devora-code-webview" "npm run watch -w devora-code-api" "npm run watch -w devora-code-sdk"
